newsitem.title: USA: U.S. state treasurers plan Mexico summit.
newsitem.headline: U.S. state treasurers plan Mexico summit.

text.p: California Treasurer Matt Fong will lead a delegation of state treasurers from across the United States to Mexico on Wednesday for a one-day investment summit, his office said.
The July 16 "Mexico Investment Summit" was organized as part of this week's National Association of State Treasurers conference in San Diego, Fong said in a statement.

The summit will include a luncheon with Mexican government officials, a roundtable with the mayor of Tijuana and Baja state government representatives, and a reception with federal, state and local officials.

"The relationship between our two countries is critically important," Fong said in a statement. "This summit will help these states identify opportunities for investment and meet with Mexican business leaders who can help them with job-creating projects in their own state."
Joining Fong on the trip to Mexico will be treasurers from 10 to 15 states, including the treasurers of Arizona, Indiana, Nevada, New Hampshire, Ohio and Pennsylvania.
Representatives of banks, financial advisory firms and the Pacific Stock Exchange will also attend, Fong's office said.
